environment.description: Kubernetes Job running in namespace 'data-migrations' on EKS cluster. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy applied to the namespace. Pod has access to instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254. Environment variables TENANT_ID and PRE_MIGRATION_HOOK are sourced from a ConfigMap that tenant admins can modify via a self-service portal. IMDSv1 is enabled on the node.
